# Suite web page never loses log bytes between list and subscribe

## What to build

Jira KAN-71 / GE-10. The Logs tab on the **suite** web page can silently lose log bytes. The shared Logs tab (`src/web/assets/logs.js`, `mountLogs`) first calls `src.list()` (GET `/api/logs`, which returns each log's `size` and last 8 KB `tail`), renders the tails, then calls `src.subscribe(labels, onChunk, sizes)` passing the byte offset each block already holds. The suite page's data source (`logsApi` in `src/web/assets/suitepage.js`, lines 373–392) drops that third `offsets` argument when it opens the SSE stream (line 382), and the suite server's `/api/logs/stream` route (`src/suite/server.ts` line 306) calls `tail.subscribe(labels)` without offsets, so `LogTail` starts each watch at the file's **current** size (`startOffset` in `src/web/logtail.ts` lines 37–40, used at line 123). Anything an agent wrote between the list and the moment the stream opens is never shown (and after an EventSource auto-reconnect, everything written while disconnected is lost too). The run page does not have this bug: its client posts the offsets (`src/web/assets/runpage.js` line 245) and its server passes them on (`src/web/server.ts` lines 474–475). This task ports that offset handling to the suite page: the client sends the offsets it has, as a query parameter on the stream URL, and the suite server starts each watch from them. `LogTail` itself already supports offsets and needs no change; the client already ignores data it has seen (`mergeTail` in `logs.js` lines 23–33), so replayed bytes are harmless.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/suite/server.ts` (lines 279–338) — `logsDirOf` and `logsRoute`: `/api/logs` (list, lines 296–300), `/api/logs/stream` (SSE, lines 301–319; the bug is line 306 `unwatch = tail.subscribe(labels);`), `/api/logs/<label>` (full log). Each stream gets its own `LogTail` (line 303), so offsets are per connection.
- `src/web/logtail.ts` (lines 37–40) — `startOffset(known, size)`: a known offset is used when it is an integer `0 <= known <= size`, else the current size. (lines 111–136) `subscribe(labels, offsets = {})`; (lines 160–180) `read()`: streams `[offset, size)` and emits `onChunk(label, start, text)`. No change needed here.
- `src/web/server.ts` (lines 457–482) — the run page's `/logs/subscribe`: reference for accepting client offsets (lines 474–475).
- `src/web/assets/suitepage.js` (lines 363–392) — `logSource(key)` and `logsApi(src)`: `subscribe(labels, onChunk)` at lines 381–385 builds `new EventSource("/api/logs/stream?labels=" + ... + feature)` and drops the offsets.
- `src/web/assets/runpage.js` (lines 238–266) — the run page's `logsApi(id).subscribe(labels, onChunk, offsets)`: the client side to mirror.
- `src/web/assets/logs.js` (lines 23–33) `mergeTail` (dedup by offset); (lines 73–76) the `src` contract: `subscribe(labels, onChunk, offsets?: Record<string, number>)`; (lines 189–208) `refresh()`: `sizes[l.label] = l.size` from the list, then `src.subscribe([...blocks.keys()], onChunk, sizes)`.
- `src/suite/server.test.ts` (lines 1–40 setup/`rawRequest`; lines 91–118 `describe("suite logs")`) — the test to extend. Task 1 (already merged) changed its append step to use `appendFile` (imported from `node:fs/promises`) instead of `writeFile` when it adds `more\n` to `features/run-a/logs/1.log`; keep that and use `appendFile` the same way in the new tests.
- `src/web/logtail.test.ts` (lines 1–35) — `LogTail` unit test pattern.
- `TESTING.md` — "Web view", "Web UI checklist" step 7 (Logs), and the rule that a UI change must be checked in a browser by you.

## Patterns to follow

**Server: accepting offsets (src/web/server.ts:473-475):**
```typescript
try {
  const offsets = body.offsets && typeof body.offsets === "object" ? (body.offsets as Record<string, number>) : {};
  stream.unwatch = tail.subscribe(labels, offsets);
}
```

**Suite stream route today (src/suite/server.ts:301-306):**
```typescript
if (pathname === "/api/logs/stream") {
  const labels = (params.get("labels") ?? "").split(",").filter((l) => l !== "");
  const tail = new LogTail(src.dir, (label, offset, text) => void res.write(`event: log\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({ label, offset, text })}\n\n`));
  let unwatch: () => void;
  try {
    unwatch = tail.subscribe(labels);
```

**Client today (src/web/assets/suitepage.js:381-385):**
```javascript
subscribe(labels, onChunk) {
  const es = new EventSource("/api/logs/stream?labels=" + labels.slice(0, 16).map(encodeURIComponent).join(",") + feature);
  es.addEventListener("log", (ev) => onChunk(JSON.parse(ev.data)));
  return () => es.close();
},
```

**Run page client (src/web/assets/runpage.js:253-256):**
```javascript
subscribe(labels, onChunk, offsets) {
  const sub = { labels: labels.slice(0, 16), onChunk, offsets };
  logSub = sub;
  postSub();
```

**Server test (src/suite/server.test.ts:109-116):**
```typescript
const chunks: string[] = [];
const req = http.get({ host: "127.0.0.1", port: server.port, path: "/api/logs/stream?feature=a&labels=1" }, (res) => res.on("data", (c) => chunks.push(String(c))));
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
// (task 1) appendFile(path.join(dir, "features", "run-a", "logs", "1.log"), "more\n")
const end = Date.now() + 2500;
while (!chunks.join("").includes("event: log") && Date.now() < end) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50));
req.destroy();
expect(chunks.join("")).toContain('data: {"label":"1","offset":5,"text":"more\\n"}');
```

**Wire format (new):** `GET /api/logs/stream?labels=<l1>,<l2>&offsets=<n1>,<n2>[&feature=<name>]` — `offsets` is a comma-separated list aligned by position with `labels`; an empty entry, a missing `offsets` parameter or a non-integer means "no offset" (start at the current size, today's behaviour). Labels match `^[\w.-]+$`, so they never contain commas.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/suite/server.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in the `/api/logs/stream` branch (lines 301–319), parse `params.get("offsets")`: `const raw = (params.get("offsets") ?? "").split(",");` then build `const offsets: Record<string, number> = {};` with `labels.forEach((l, i) => { const v = raw[i]; if (v !== undefined && /^\d+$/.test(v)) offsets[l] = Number(v); });` and call `unwatch = tail.subscribe(labels, offsets);` (line 306). Keep the rest of the route (error codes 400/404, headers, ping, close handling) unchanged. Out-of-range values need no check here: `startOffset` in `logtail.ts` falls back to the current size.
- **PATTERN**: `src/web/server.ts:474-475`.
- **IMPORTS**: none new.
- **GOTCHA**: the label filter at line 302 drops empty labels (`.filter((l) => l !== "")`); compute the offsets from the same split BEFORE filtering, or filter label/offset pairs together, so positions stay aligned (e.g. split both, zip, then drop pairs whose label is empty).
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run src/suite/server.test.ts`

### UPDATE `src/web/assets/suitepage.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**: change `logsApi(src).subscribe` (lines 381–385) to `subscribe(labels, onChunk, offsets)`: `const list = labels.slice(0, 16);` and append `"&offsets=" + list.map((l) => (offsets && Number.isInteger(offsets[l]) ? offsets[l] : "")).join(",")` to the stream URL (before `+ feature`). Keep `es.addEventListener("log", ...)` and the returned `() => es.close()` as they are.
- **PATTERN**: `src/web/assets/runpage.js:253-256` (takes the third `offsets` arg from `mountLogs`).
- **GOTCHA**: this file is plain browser JS served from `src/web/assets/` (copied to `dist/web/assets` by `npm run build`), no TypeScript and no bundler: keep it ES2020, no imports added. Do not change `logs.js` — it already passes `sizes` as the third argument and dedups replayed bytes with `mergeTail`; an EventSource auto-reconnect reuses the same URL, so it replays from the original offsets and nothing written while disconnected is lost.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx eslint src/web/assets/suitepage.js`

### UPDATE `src/suite/server.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `describe("suite logs")` add:
  - "streams from the client's offsets, so text written between list and subscribe is not lost" — `setup()`, create `features/run-a/logs/1.log` with `task\n`; `GET /api/logs?feature=a` returns `size: 5`; then `appendFile(..., "gap\n")` (the write that lands between list and subscribe); open `http.get` on `/api/logs/stream?feature=a&labels=1&offsets=5` and, WITHOUT writing anything else, wait up to 2.5 s for `event: log`; expect `data: {"label":"1","offset":5,"text":"gap\\n"}`.
  - "falls back to the current size for a missing, invalid or out-of-range offset" — file `task\n`; open three streams (`offsets=999`, `offsets=abc`, no `offsets`) for `labels=1`, wait 200 ms, `appendFile(..., "more\n")`, and expect each stream to contain `data: {"label":"1","offset":5,"text":"more\\n"}` and no event with offset 0. Each stream answers 200 (no 400).
  - "aligns offsets with labels" — two logs in the suite's own `logs/` dir (`code-r1.log` = `review\n`, `code-r2.log` = `x\n`), append `A\n` to code-r1 and `B\n` to code-r2, then stream `/api/logs/stream?labels=code-r1,code-r2&offsets=7,` (offset for code-r1 only); expect `{"label":"code-r1","offset":7,"text":"A\\n"}` without any further write; code-r2 starts at its current size (no event for it until it grows).
- **PATTERN**: `src/suite/server.test.ts:109-116`; destroy each request at the end (`req.destroy()`).
- **IMPORTS**: `appendFile` from `node:fs/promises` (task 1 already added it to the import list; add it if missing).
- **GOTCHA**: `LogTail` polls once per second (`POLL_MS`) plus an `fs.watch`; give the wait loop 2.5 s like the existing test.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/suite/server.test.ts`

### UPDATE `src/web/logtail.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: "starts at a known offset, streaming what was written before subscribe" — file `3.log` = `abc\n`, `appendFileSync(..., "hello\n")`, `tail.subscribe(["3"], { "3": 4 })`, no further write; expect `got` to become `[["3", 4, "hello\n"]]` within 2 s. This pins the `LogTail` contract the suite server now relies on.
- **PATTERN**: `src/web/logtail.test.ts:16-26`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/logtail.test.ts`

### CHECK the suite page in a browser (required by TESTING.md for UI changes)

- **IMPLEMENT**: `npm run build`, then start a suite with a hanging task, as in TESTING.md "Web view" (same two environment variables): `REPO=$(mktemp -d)`, copy `demo/suite/auth`, `demo/suite/export`, `demo/suite/PRD-*.md` into it, commit with `-c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t`, write `{"task:auth2":{"attempts":[{"hang":true}]}}` to `$REPO/.git/fake.json`, then `cd "$REPO" && GRAPH_EXECUTION_HANDOFF=detached SSH_CONNECTION=1 GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT=$REPO/.git/fake.json node <repo>/dist/cli.js suite --feature auth:PRD-auth.md --feature export:PRD-export.md --provider fake --concurrency 2 --web` (prints the URL). Find the hanging task's log: `ls $REPO/.graph-execution/suite-*/features/*/logs/`.
- Drive the page with Playwright (preinstalled: `require("/opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright")` from a `.cjs` script; Chromium is found through `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers`, already set). `agent-browser` from TESTING.md is not installed here; Playwright replaces it. At 1280×800: click the running node (`.node.s-running`), open the `[data-tab="logs"]` tab. From the shell, append numbered lines (`line-1` … `line-300`) to that `.log` file every 10 ms, and while it runs close and reopen the Logs tab (click another node, then the running node again) 5 times. Afterwards read `document.querySelector("#panel").innerText` and check every `line-N` appears exactly once, in order. Take a screenshot and LOOK at it. Expected: no missing and no duplicated lines. (Before the fix, lines written between the list and the stream opening are missing.)
- **GOTCHA**: clean up: kill the pid in the suite's `web.json` or press **Close**; remove the temp repo.
- **VALIDATE**: the script's output (`missing: []`, `duplicates: []`) and the screenshot path go into your report.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/logs/stream?labels=1&offsets=5&feature=a` on a log of 9 bytes streams `{"label":"1","offset":5,"text":"<bytes 5..9>"}` right away, without any further write.
- [ ] A missing, empty, non-integer or larger-than-file offset starts at the current size (old behaviour); the response is still 200 `text/event-stream`. Invalid labels still answer 400, unknown ones 404.
- [ ] Offsets are matched to labels by position; a label without an offset starts at the current size.
- [ ] The suite page's Logs tab passes the offsets it has (`mountLogs`'s `sizes`) in the stream URL; in the browser, text appended between opening the tab and the stream starting is shown exactly once, and reopening the tab or a reconnect loses nothing.
- [ ] The run page is unchanged (`src/web/server.test.ts` stays green).
- [ ] Tests pass: `npx vitest run src/suite/server.test.ts src/web/logtail.test.ts src/web/server.test.ts src/web/assets/logs.test.ts`

## Validation commands

```bash
# Type / lint
npx tsc --noEmit
npx eslint .

# Tests for this slice
npx vitest run src/suite/server.test.ts src/web/logtail.test.ts src/web/server.test.ts src/web/assets/logs.test.ts

# Quick manual check of the endpoint (after `npm run build` and starting a suite with --web as above)
curl -sN "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/api/logs/stream?feature=auth&labels=auth2&offsets=0" | head -5
# expected: an `event: log` with offset 0 and the log's whole text, without writing to the log
```
